## Change

Describe the problem and the user-visible result. Link the issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the build, lint and tests you ran. For network changes, include both phone models, Android versions, route, screen state and resume or checksum results. For UI changes, include an accessible screenshot and the font scale or motion settings tested.

## Compatibility

Describe any effect on existing pairings, stored messages, partially transferred files or required permissions.
